title.zh: TUN 虚拟网卡模式原理深度解析：从 OSI 第三层网络包拦截看系统代理与 TUN 的本质区别
title.en: TUN Virtual Interface & OSI Layer 3 Architecture: Deep Dive into Packet Interception vs System Proxy

cluster.zh: TUN 虚拟网卡深度分流

description.zh: 技术深度硬核剖析：操作系统网络协议栈中 TUN 虚拟网卡（Layer 3 IP Packet）的工作机制。对比 TAP（Layer 2 Ethernet）与应用层系统代理的本质差异，解析路由表重定向与 Fake-IP 封包流转全景路径。
description.en: Hardcore technical breakdown of TUN (Layer 3) network packet interception within OS networking stacks. Analyze the architectural differences between TUN, TAP, and L7 proxies, packet redirection mechanics, and Fake-IP translation lifecycles.
